name: Animo Media Intelligence
description_en:
Animo measures and plans media investment across offline and online channels. Its product family separates offline optimization, a pre-campaign media planner, a digital dashboard, online marketing mix modeling (MMM), and the combined Animo 360 offering. Buying a dashboard does not automatically buy the modeling or planning modules.

The distinctive documented proposition is offline measurement at 15-minute resolution alongside digital reporting and modeled allocation recommendations. This is a vendor description of measurement granularity, not proof of causal accuracy or a guaranteed reporting latency. A useful evaluation starts with the outcome series and media schedule your business can actually supply.
description_zh:
Animo 用于衡量与规划线上、线下媒体投入。产品分为线下优化、投放前媒体规划器、数字渠道仪表盘、线上营销组合模型（MMM）和整合版 Animo 360。购买仪表盘不等于同时获得建模与规划模块。

其文档特色是以 15 分钟粒度衡量线下媒体，同时提供数字报表和模型驱动的预算建议。这是厂商对衡量粒度的说明，不是因果准确性实证或报表延迟保证。评估应先检查企业实际能提供的结果时间序列和媒体排期。

core_features.explanation_en: Relates TV, OOH, radio and print activity to business outcomes at a documented 15-minute resolution.
core_features.explanation_zh: 文档描述以 15 分钟粒度关联电视、户外、广播、报纸活动与业务结果。

core_features.name_zh: 模块化线上看板与 MMM
core_features.explanation_en: Digital reporting and causal modeling are separately priced capabilities.
core_features.explanation_zh: 数字报表与因果建模是分别定价的能力。

core_features.explanation_en: Models budget-allocation scenarios before booking placements; requires the offline plan.
core_features.explanation_zh: 预订媒体前模拟预算分配情境，需要线下方案。

target_audience.organization_sizes_en: Select by workflow, volume and governance needs; no universal size claim.
target_audience.organization_sizes_zh: 按流程、用量与治理需求选择，不宣称适合所有规模。

steps.en: Start with one channel, one outcome and a defined observation window. Ask onboarding staff what schedule, spend and outcome history each selected module requires and how missing intervals are handled. API and MCP access are listed across plans; dashboard and online MMM have self-service integration, while offline modules have a different onboarding path. The public platform is hosted; no self-hosted distribution or open-source license was established.
steps.zh: 从一个渠道、一个结果指标和明确观察区间开始。向入门支持确认所选模块要求哪些排期、支出和历史结果，以及缺失区间如何处理。各方案列有 API 和 MCP；看板及线上 MMM 支持自助接入，线下模块的入门路径不同。本次读取的是托管平台，未确认可自托管发行版或开源许可。

items.en: Shortlist Animo when offline spend needs to be studied alongside digital activity and the team can supply aligned data. A native advertising report may suffice for delivery counts; a spreadsheet can compare budgets but does not reproduce a fitted MMM. The website does not establish identification assumptions, uncertainty intervals or recovery guarantees for your dataset. If a feed stops or a placement is misdated, reconcile inputs before treating a recommendation as a buying instruction.
items.zh: 当需要把线下支出与线上活动合并研究，而且团队能提供对齐数据时，可列入候选。仅需投放数量时，广告平台自带报表可能足够；表格可以比较预算，但不等于拟合后的 MMM。官网未确认你这套数据的识别假设、置信区间或恢复保证。若数据源中断或广告时间错误，应先核对输入，再决定是否按建议采购。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The pricing page advertises the online dashboard from $75/month, with a 14-day trial and no card. Offline optimization starts at $2,000/month; the planner adds $1,500/month, making Offline + Planner $3,500/month. Dashboard + online MMM is listed at $1,750/month, Offline + Online at $2,750, and Animo 360 at $5,750. These are starting prices, not quotes for every dataset. The page mixes flat-rate language with data-volume and media-spend scaling for MMM; obtain a written basis. A trial is not sustained free use.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 定价页宣传线上看板每月 75 美元起，提供 14 天免信用卡试用。线下优化每月 2,000 美元起；规划器加价每月 1,500 美元，组合价为 3,500 美元。看板加线上 MMM 为每月 1,750 美元，线下加线上为 2,750 美元，Animo 360 为 5,750 美元。这些是起价，不能代替所有数据规模的报价。MMM 同时出现固定费率、数据量与媒体支出扩展说明，应索取书面计价依据。试用不等于持续免费。

sections.title_en: A TV campaign and its digital aftermath
sections.title_zh: 电视活动与随后数字响应的分析流程
sections.en: An illustrative advertiser supplies a broadcast schedule and a time-indexed outcome such as visits or orders. Use offline optimization to examine modeled changes around placements; combine the digital dashboard only if online channel reporting is also required. The planner addresses the next campaign: specify the KPI and budget, then compare allocation scenarios before reserving inventory. Keep input definitions and time zones consistent. Do not compare a raw platform click count with a modeled incremental outcome as if they were the same metric.
sections.zh: 例如，广告主提供广播排期和按时间记录的访问或订单等结果，用线下优化查看广告时段附近的模型变化；需要线上渠道报表时再组合数字看板。规划器面向下一轮活动：指定 KPI 和预算，在预订资源前比较分配情境。输入定义与时区应保持一致，不应把平台原始点击数和模型增量结果视为同一指标。
